Persistent Systems Ltd., | Dec 2023- June 2026 Banking Domain Consultant

Role & Responsibilities-





Served as Banking Subject Matter Expert for Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Wholesale Banking, Core Banking, Payments, Lending, Mortgage, Risk, Treasury, and Digital Banking transformation projects. Provided domain expertise on banking products including CASA, Deposits, Loans, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Corporate Lending, Mortgage, and Trade Finance.

Guided Business Analysts during requirement elicitation, requirement

validation, and solution design.

Validated BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, and



Acceptance Criteria from a business perspective. Reviewed business process flows, As-Is and To-Be models, operational procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Conducted stakeholder workshops to identify business needs, process







gaps, and improvement opportunities. Supported implementation of KYC, AML, CDD, EDD, Fraud Detection, Transaction Monitoring, and Customer Onboarding solutions. Provided expertise on Payments including NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, SWIFT, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, Visa, Mastercard, and RuPay. Supported Credit Risk, Operational Risk, Basel III, IFRS 9, PD, LGD, EAD, RWA, SPPI Test, and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) initiatives.

Worked closely with developers to clarify business rules, workflows, API





integrations, and data mapping requirements. Supported SIT, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, and post- production issue resolution. Reviewed SQL data validation reports, reconciliation reports, and production metrics.

Assisted Product Owners with backlog prioritization, business value

assessment, and release planning.

Conducted knowledge transfer sessions and mentored Business Analysts

on banking domain concepts and regulatory compliance.

Bandhan Bank Ltd., | Jan 2019 – Dec 2023 Lead Business Analyst/ Product Owner

Role & Responsibilities-

• Owned product vision, roadmap, and backlog for Digital Banking, Payments, Lending, and Core Banking transformation

initiatives.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, SMEs, customers, and development teams to define product strategy. • • Defined Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Release Plans. • Managed Agile delivery using Scrum and Kanban methodologies. • Conducted Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Release Planning sessions. • Worked closely with UX teams to review wireframes, prototypes, and customer journeys. • Coordinated API integrations, REST services, Microservices architecture, and third-party system integrations. • • Collaborated with QA teams for UAT planning, production validation, and release management. • Monitored product KPIs, customer feedback, production incidents, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Worked with Data Analytics teams using SQL, dashboards, Power BI, and Tableau to monitor product performance. • Coordinated cross-functional teams across Retail Banking, Payments, Lending, Risk, Treasury, and Compliance. Ensured product compliance with KYC, AML, Basel III, IFRS 9, PCI DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, and regulatory requirements.

Prioritized Product Backlog using business value, customer impact, regulatory requirements, and MoSCoW prioritization.

Axis Bank Ltd., | Oct 2017 – Dec 2018 Senior Business Analyst

Role & Responsibilities-



Led requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, compliance teams, and development teams.

Managed end-to-end Business Analysis activities across multiple Agile projects. • Defined project scope, business objectives, solution approach, and implementation roadmap. •

Reviewed and approved BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Functional Specifications, and Acceptance Criteria prepared by Business Analysts. Facilitated requirement workshops, Joint Application Development (JAD) sessions, and stakeholder meetings. Performed enterprise-level Gap Analysis, Impact Assessment, Business Process Reengineering (BPR), and Solution Assessment. Led cross-functional teams across Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Core Banking, Treasury, and Risk Management projects.

• •

Coordinated Agile ceremonies, backlog prioritization, release planning, sprint planning, and dependency management. • Worked closely with Product Owners to prioritize Epics, Features, and User Stories. Ensured Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) compliance throughout the SDLC. • • Directed UAT planning, defect triage, production validation, and Hypercare support. • Coordinated API integrations, Data Mapping, System Integrations, and migration projects. • Mentored junior Business Analysts and conducted peer reviews of project documentation. • Collaborated with regulatory teams to support Basel III, IFRS 9, AML/KYC, and compliance initiatives. Prepared executive dashboards, project status reports, RAID logs, and stakeholder presentations. •

HDFC Bank Ltd., | Sep 2012 – Oct 2017 Business Analyst

Role & Responsibilities-

Gathered and analyzed business requirements for banking products and process improvements. • • • Worked on requirement documentation, stakeholder coordination, UAT, and production support. • Supported Agile and Waterfall delivery models for banking transformation projects.

Led business analysis activities for banking transformation initiatives across Lending, Mortgage, Payments and Core Banking. Prepared BRD, FRD, RTM, process flows, use cases, and functional specifications.

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business, functional, and non-functional requirements through stakeholder workshops

and requirement elicitation sessions.



Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), Software Requirement Specifications (SRS), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), User Stories, Epics, Features, and Acceptance Criteria.



Performed Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), SWOT Analysis, Feasibility Analysis, and Process Analysis to identify business improvement opportunities.

Created As-Is and To-Be process flows, workflow diagrams, UML use cases, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, wireframes,

mockups, and business process documentation.

• Collaborated with Product Owners, SMEs, Developers, QA teams, Architects, and business stakeholders throughout the Software

Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

• Managed product backlog items using JIRA and maintained project documentation in Confluence.

Participated in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives. Prepared Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure complete traceability from requirements through testing. • Executed SQL queries for data validation, data analysis, reconciliation, and production support. • • Conducted Data Mapping, Data Validation, Data Migration analysis, and ETL validation activities. • •

•

Supported API integration testing using REST APIs, JSON, XML, Swagger, and Postman. Prepared UAT Test Scenarios and Test Cases and coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT), SIT, Regression Testing, and defect management.

Worked on Retail Banking, Core Banking, Digital Banking, Payments, Lending, Mortgage, KYC/AML, and Customer Onboarding



initiatives. Supported production deployment, Hypercare activities, incident management, and release management.

American Home Mortgage Services/Homeward | Aug 2006 – Aug 2012 Underwriter

Role & Responsibilities-

• Conducted DTI calculations, asset verification, debt reconciliation, and appraisal reviews. • Ensured mortgage compliance and underwriting quality standards.

Performed underwriting and loan assessment using the 4C framework (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral).

MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, Oracle Flexcube, Finacle, Newgen, FinOne, Agile (Scrum) Model,

Angular, Postman, Swagger / Open API, SoapUI, XML/JSON validators

Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, NIFI, Kafka.
